title: Show live optimizer activity through an inspectable app panel
description: During labeling show a compact status of trigger checks, queued/running optimization, ML fit, completion or error without covering article/vote controls. Open a right drawer/panel for live activity; drill into exact optimizer request with full trusted-label explanations, response/tool calls, decision request/response with actual example text and labels, before/after rubric/questions/examples/head, candidate evaluation and promotion/rejection reason. Use provider-neutral names, not Luna-specific UI. API cursor subscriptions update without reload; reconnect deduplicates events and recovers current job state. Feedback-save acknowledgement is separate from optimization completion; do not leave UI disabled or silently retry paid calls. Acceptance: fake GraphQL/UI cycle shows each phase and precise exchanges; mobile status/drawer remains readable; submitting labels responds immediately and eventual errors are actionable.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live activity now has a right drawer independent of labeling layout; retains exact event inspector and expands recent activity to triggers, stage starts/failures, labels and metrics. No fullscreen toggle remains. Remaining: structured per-stage status, paired exchanges and full context inspector acceptance, reconnect/recovery fixture verification.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live activity inspector now pairs requests/responses using durable classifier, step and briefing identities. Selecting an optimizer response shows its full prompt/context and tool calls, not another classifiers nearby request. Decision inspection filters target+cycle+step. Exact cached decision requests displayed separately; missing correlation explicitly unavailable. Three regression tests added. Remaining: real browser acceptance on recorded multi-round events and richer before/after summaries.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Browser acceptance against the real recorded three-classifier session: selecting latest optimizer response (cycle 81) rendered its paired full system/user request plus response/tool calls. User context contains 47 feedback items and one human_explanations entry. Added activity-type filter to reach optimizer exchanges despite newer decision traffic and drill-down replaces the list with Back to activity rather than burying details below 40 rows. No model calls or human labels during verification. Evidence screenshot var/web/paired-optimizer-exchange.png. Remaining: before/after structured summaries and broader tablet acceptance.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added a compact event-derived Flywheel activity summary in labeling, separate from feedback-save acknowledgement. It names classifier/stage and distinguishes request sent, response awaiting validation, fitting, selection, accepted/no change, partial failure, waiting, budget pause and command failure. Native trigger-evaluated/step lifecycle events now appear in the activity drawer; no-op checks do not erase the last optimization outcome. Inspecting completed rubric/examples/questions steps now correlates exact optimizer requests and responses using durable scope, not temporal proximity. Specs observed failing first; 125 UI tests and build pass. Browser verified real recorded 85-cycle run shows Anthus ML optimization Accepted with its actual reason, opens exact completion event and retains the optimizer exchange filter; no console errors, new votes or paid calls. Screenshot var/web/live-activity-status-proof.jpg. React skill kept status purely derived; verification used existing API-owned history. Structured before/after configuration and broader tablet/reconnect acceptance remain open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added structured before/after optimization snapshots to the live activity inspector. It displays applied rubric, main/supporting questions with classes/counts, examples with recorded training labels/text/comments, dynamic elements, raw passthrough vs learned-head features and calibration temperature/OOF origin. Snapshots and example evidence are scoped by durable step/classifier/cycle identities; missing older records are explicitly unavailable, and proposals cannot masquerade as applied rubrics. Four specs first failed, then passed; all 129 UI specs and build pass, focused final inspector tests/build pass. Browser verified real cycle-81 optimizer response renders both actual rubric versions, acceptance reason and changed calibrated head plus its paired full optimizer request/response, without model calls or votes. React kept transformation pure and disclosures native; verification checked existing API-owned history. Broad tablet/reconnect story acceptance remains open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Hardened the read-only GraphQL event connection. Seven no-network fake-WebSocket specs cover cursor resume/deduplication, closed-connection frames, malformed messages/invalid events, operation errors/completion, auth stop, duplicate acknowledgements, cleanup and missing-ack timeout. Five existing behaviors failed first, plus timeout failed before implementation. Client now uses connection-local handlers, validates event shape, reconnects after recoverable stream failures, stops auth denial retries and explicitly completes its subscription on cleanup. Full UI regression 136 passed; production build and focused lint pass. Two server transport/cursor specs pass. Actual offline fixture websocket verification received sequence 1 then sequence 2 after reconnect, with zero mutations; browser shows Connected and no console errors. No user labels, model calls or authentication requirements changed. Verification skill traced API-owned persisted events through transport and client. Broader tablet/dark/job recovery acceptance remains open.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Tablet activity acceptance found and fixed a real stale-error bug: an invalid run load left unknown run visible after navigating to a valid recording. Added a failing-first WebApp regression; failure state is now scoped to run/section and rendered only in that workspace, with callback dependencies explicit and no new state-clearing effect. 167 UI tests and production build pass; focused oxlint has only four existing set-state-in-effect warnings, no new hook warnings. Read-only browser check on actual saved diagnostic pilot, requested tablet viewport (reported CSS viewport 1025x1475), opens optimizer filter and selects cycle81 response: full system/user context, response and tools present; no horizontal overflow or console errors; close returns to workspace with no alert/dialog. Screenshot private var/web/tablet-activity-exchange-proof.png. No model calls, votes, prepare commands or production mutations. Broader live phase/recovery/tablet acceptance remains open; this is a concrete navigation fix, not an experiment report.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added an explicitly scripted, fake-only optimizer-activity fixture: forty alternating reviews per classifier through the real API/SQLite/worker, all three independent context controls, exact requests/responses/tool-call evidence, fitting and candidate evaluation. No provider credentials or paid clients. Regression forbids paid factory, verifies 80 submitted labels, all three control scopes, explanations, fits, completed jobs and a pending unlabelled item. Browser acceptance found and fixed final-item acknowledgement disappearing: completed sessions now retain saved-label feedback, show Session complete and remove Prepare next item. Failing-first UI spec; 168 UI tests/build passed, 852 Python tests passed. Actual isolated browser submission immediately showed waiting-to-record, then 2 labels recorded / Your feedback is saved / Session complete; no console errors, all 86 fixture commands completed, append-only undo preserved (84 feedback records, 2 retractions). Screenshot var/web/scripted-activity-completion-proof.png. Broader real-time phase/tablet acceptance remains open; fixture probabilities are not model-quality evidence.
